title: Paul Before Governor Felix
description: The high priest Ananias and the lawyer Tertullus accuse Paul of rebellion and attempting to desecrate the temple. Paul defends himself before Governor Felix and confesses his faith in the Way and the resurrection of both the righteous and the unrighteous. Felix postpones the case but later summons Paul together with his wife Drusilla to hear about faith in Christ Jesus. He hopes for a bribe and keeps Paul imprisoned for two more years until Porcius Festus takes over.
